enrichments.summary: WPS, under the 'Fresh & Finest' brand, has recalled its 'Cut Fresh Luau Blend Fruit Mix' due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes. The product is packaged in 4/10 oz containers.
Recall of 'Cut Fresh Fruit Tray with Strawberries' (2.5 LB Harvest Cuts, UPC 7 90629-08132 9) packed by WPS, Minneapolis, MN, due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination.

WPS of Minneapolis, MN is recalling various sizes of Cut Fresh Cantaloupe Chunks and Cantaloupe Spears, sold under brand names Fresh & Finest and Harvest Cuts, due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes.
WPS in Minneapolis, MN, has recalled various brands and sizes of Cut Fresh Fruit Mix, including Cantaloupe, Honeydew, and Red Grapes, due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination.
WPS of Minneapolis, MN, is recalling 'Cut Fresh Fruit with Fruit Dip' sold under the brands Fresh & Finest and Harvest Cuts, due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination.
Wholesale Produce Supply is recalling cucumbers due to potential contamination with Salmonella. The recalled cucumbers were sold in various pack sizes.
WPS, Minneapolis, MN, is recalling 'Cut Fresh Cantaloupe & Honeydew Chunks' due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination.
WPS of Minneapolis, MN is recalling Cut Fresh Melon Mix packed under the 'Melon Mix HC Harvest Cuts' and 'Melon Mix CHW (MCT)' brands due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes.
WPS, Minneapolois, MN, is recalling 'Cut Fresh Fruit Mix' products, including Fruit Mix CHWG and Melon Mix Bowl & Grapes, due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination.
Harvest Cuts Fruit Tray with Watermelons, packed by WPS, Minneapolois, MN, is being recalled due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes.

WPS, Minneapolis, MN has issued a recall for 'Cut Fresh Fruit Salad' (6/6 oz. and 4/16 oz. 'Harvest Cuts' containing Cantaloupe, Honeydew, Red Grape, Strawberry) due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes.

WPS of Minneapolis, MN, is recalling Cut Fresh Fruit Mix products, including Fruit Mix CHPG (MCT), Fruit Medley "HC", and Fruit Mix CHPG (PAIL), due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes.
